source.estimatedFrom: Population-scaled finite opening allocation over recorded employers and already recorded compatible employee roles. Initial seed order distributes who held opening positions among supported real options; it never selects a future application, hire, firing or desired biography. Unsupported reference weight stays omitted.

assumptions.estimatedFrom: Count generated resident ages, apply supplied valid county B23001 civilian employed/population by age, or explicit national CPS age ratio times missing-county tunable scale. Subtract preserved opening employees. Rates allocate fictional starting records only.
assumptions.calibrationGap: Hidalgo County has official 2020–2024 ACS five-year age cells from the static Census summary file. Other counties remain unprovided and use the explicitly tunable national proxy; no local or territorial rate is inferred. Known enrollment/care/jail eligibility restricts supply, not the resident denominator; residual targets remain unfilled. Applying later survey estimates to the opening date is an estimate.
